description: Use this when an Extraction request's email did not arrive (emailProblem is set, or the user says the address was wrong) and the user has told you which address to use: a corrected or different address, or the same one to try again. Only the person who sent the request can do this, before the participant accepts it; never for a self Extraction. Sending takes two calls. The first call never sends: it returns sent false with the details and an idempotencyKey. Show the user the address and wait for their reply. Only after they say yes, call again with the same values and that idempotencyKey. RuleFoundry then emails a new link to that address; the earlier link stops working. Never choose an address yourself and never retry without the user's yes. The result has the same shape as a created request, with emailDelivery and emailProblem for the new attempt.

confirmSend.description: Always true. The user's yes is given to the preview the first call returns.

idempotencyKey.description: On the first call, any fresh opaque key. After the user says yes, the idempotencyKey the preview returned.

participantEmail.description: The exact address the user gave: a new one, or the same one to retry.

name: rulefoundry_update_extraction_request_email

emailDelivery.description: The invitation email: not_applicable for a self Extraction; sent when our email service accepted it; delivered or bounced when the recipient's mail server reported so; failed when it could not be sent; unknown with no recorded outcome. The request exists in every case.

canRetry.description: True when sending to the same address again usually works.

message.description: Plain words for the user, naming the address. Tell them this.

emailProblem.description: Why the invitation email did not arrive, or null. When set, tell the user the message and ask whether to send to a different address or try again; never pick an address yourself and never retry without their yes (rulefoundry_update_extraction_request_email).

idempotencyKey.description: Pass this back, with the same values, only after the user says yes.

title: Send an Extraction request to another address
